how_to_apply: Visit the official AWEIL notice page at https://www.aweil.in/notice.
Locate the relevant advertisement: No. 7150/R&D Expert/Estt/2026 for Expert/Specialist posts or No. 7193/RB/Hindi Post App. for Junior Translation Officer and Hindi Typist.
Read the detailed notification carefully to confirm eligibility, educational qualifications, experience and application instructions.
Follow the application procedure and submit the online application as directed in the relevant detailed notification.
Complete the application within the deadline applicable to the selected advertisement.
The supplied short advertisements do not provide a direct application form URL or a complete list of required documents. Refer to the detailed advertisement for those instructions.

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These engagements are on a fixed tenure contract basis under Ordnance Factory Tiruchirappalli.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 09 vacancies are announced across multiple posts under the 2026 recruitment notifications.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the R&D Expert posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment Newspaper i.e., 10.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. Where can I check the detailed eligibility criteria and qualifications?
faq.answer: Detailed information regarding qualification, age, and other eligibility conditions is available on the AWEIL website at https://www.aweil.in/notice.
